items.title: PRAISED
items.quote: Great is Hashem and [He is] most acclaimed in the city of our G-d, His holy mountain.
items.text: Yerushalayim is the place where the greatness of Hashem as Master of the universe is most clearly perceived. It is there that the intensity of His presence is most felt and so it is there that Hashem is seen as truly great.

items.quote: [Yerushalayim is] beautiful in its setting, the joy of all the land.

items.title: DISPLAY OF POWER
items.quote: [It was like the] east wind [with which] You smashed the ships of Tarshish.
items.text: Hashem will stop the attackers of Yerushalayim as though they had been struck by a catastrophic east wind.

items.quote: Just as we heard, so did we see in the city of Hashem, Master of Legions, in the city of our G-d.

items.title: KINDNESS
items.quote: We hoped, O G-d, for Your kindness in the midst of Your Sanctuary.
items.text: We continue to have bitachon that in Hashem’s kindness He will protect us.

items.title: STERN JUSTICE
items.quote: Just as Your Name is Elokim, so is Your praise to the ends of the earth.
items.text: He metes out stern justice to the enemies of Yerushalayim.

items.title: RIGHTEOUS JUSTICE
items.quote: Righteous justice fills Your right hand.

items.title: JOY
items.quote: Har Tzion rejoices and the ‘daughters’ of Yehudah (surrounding towns), are delighted because of Your judgments.
items.text: The people of Yerushalayim express their gratitude.

items.title: DEVOTION
items.quote: This is G-d, our G-d, forever and ever, He will guide us beyond death.
items.text: Our devotion to Hashem is felt most intensely in Yerushalayim.
